name: Asurion
why: Largest 'other' record by reach (~300M covered customers); national device/tech protection brand with its own My Account billing.

name: Sunrun (incl. former Vivint Solar)
why: Largest US residential solar lease/PPA biller (~705k customers); own Sunrun account portal and AutoPay.

name: Tesla Energy (solar lease/PPA billing)
why: ~323k solar lease/PPA customers; billing in the Tesla account/app.

name: Sunnova (serviced by SunStrong Management)
why: ~245k solar customers; SunStrong portal. Chosen once for SunStrong (SunPower legacy and SunStrong records share the same billing site).

name: Progressive Leasing
why: National lease-to-own provider at major retailers; own customer portal with payments and autopay.

name: Rent-A-Center
why: Largest US rent-to-own chain; online account with payments and AutoPay.

name: Aaron's (lease-to-own)
why: Major national lease-to-own retailer; customer account with online payments and autopay.

name: AppleCare (monthly or annual)
why: Very widely held device protection subscription; billed via Apple Account.

name: Acima (lease-to-own)
why: National lease-to-own provider at thousands of retailers (Upbound); own customer portal with ACH/card autopay and online payments. Replaces Allstate Protection Plans, whose public pages publish almost no billing detail (plans mostly prepaid at the retailer).

name: DTE Home Protection Plus (HPP)
why: ~225k customers; well-known Michigan utility-affiliated home repair plan with its own billing.
